The '''Prototype Construction and Design Support Division''' was one of the [[Maw Installation]]'s organizations. The Division was originally headed by [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Tabbot]], but after he was killed in an industrial accident, Director [[Tol Sivron]] assigned himself as Acting Director until an appropriate successor could be found.
